meta.title: Meadow & Churn — dairy with a little more time
meta.description: Small-batch milk, cultured cream, and golden ghee from the foothills of Murree.

brand.name: Meadow & Churn
brand.tagline: Dairy with a little more time

hero.eyebrow: From the green edge of Murree
hero.title: Good dairy takes its time.
hero.body: Morning milk, slow cultures, and the kind of care you can taste in the last spoonful.
hero.artLabel: Illustration of the Meadow and Churn dairy shelf

story.title: Made close to the meadow.
story.body: We are a tiny dairy house built around one simple idea: if we know the herd, the land, and the hands behind the churn, we can make better food.
story.detail1Body: Our cream-top milk travels from pasture to bottle in under 18 hours.
story.detail2Body: Every yogurt and cheese gets a patient ferment and a real name.
story.detail3Body: We pay partner farms on quality, consistency, and care—not volume alone.
story.pullQuote: The best flavour is usually the one you did not rush.

products.title: Four staples, made properly.
products.body: Keep a little good in the fridge. Every batch is dated, traceable, and made in limited quantities.

milk.name: Glass-Bottle Milk
milk.description: Rich, cream-top milk from morning milking. Best poured cold over tea or warm toast.

cheese.name: Kashmiri Feta
cheese.description: Briny, crumbly, and bright with a clean finish. A little block goes a long way.

yogurt.name: Wildflower Yogurt
yogurt.description: Thick-set yogurt with a gentle tang and a spoonable, cloud-soft texture.

ghee.name: Hearth Ghee
ghee.description: Clarified butter cooked low and slow until nutty, golden, and deeply aromatic.

practice.title: A shorter distance from pasture to plate.
practice.body: We work with three family-run farms around the foothills. They know every animal by temperament; we know every batch by its date.
practice.list1: Grazing-first feed, with no routine growth hormones
practice.list2: Reusable glass bottles collected on the next delivery
practice.list3: Cold-chain delivery in small, planned routes

testimonials.title: A few words from regulars.
testimonials.quote1: The milk has that old-fashioned cream line, but the service is wonderfully modern.
testimonials.quote2: The yogurt is the first thing gone at breakfast. My children now ask for the glass jar.
testimonials.quote3: Their ghee makes a simple daal taste like someone cared all afternoon.

contact.title: Tell us what your fridge is missing.
